messages:
elaine - partnerships: Heads up — Nimbus + OrbitEdge embedded partner roundtable confirmed for 2025-05-14 11:00 PT. Need: 2 speakers, live demo fallback plan, swag kit list, and AV checklist. cc @sophia - marketing and @raj - solutions.
sophia - marketing: Awesome. Do we have speaker names from Nimbus yet? need headshots + bios by EOW for the event page.
elaine - partnerships: Alex from Nimbus (cc'ed) will speak. OrbitEdge wants a short HW demo (15m). We'll need a fallback if their rig doesn't arrive.
alex - nimbus-partner: Confirming: i'll be on the panel. sending headshot/bio by tomorrow morning. OrbitEdge will ship a dev box for the demo.
raj - solutions: I'll own demo fallback. Plan is to prepare a recording + a containerized emulation of the device that we can run on Redwood Dedicated if the hardware fails. :white_check_mark:
ben - eng: Can you share the container spec? I'd like to prewarm an instance and test quantized model perf. also need model variant name and sequence length targets.
raj - solutions: Prototype container is here: https://git.something/repo/embed-emulator (we'll add readme). For the talk we should use model variant: redwood/aligned-13b-q4_
kai - ops: Shipping cutoff for swag/dev box is 2025-05-06 to hit venue on time. who's owning the kitting and courier? we should avoid last-minute customs delays (OrbitEdge hardware crosses border).
elaine - partnerships: I'll coordinate kitting. Sophia will handle swag creative. Kai pls book courier once we have manifest.
sophia - marketing: Ok — proposed swag bundle: sticker pack, 1-pager, microfiber lens cloth with partnership logo, and a limited run enamel pin. Need SKU qtys by Mon.
shipping-bot: Tracking preload created: MANIFEST-5382. Please add courier and weight. https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-webinar-kits
ben - eng: For the fallback flow, suggest we stage this run-of-show snippet in a staging namespace. If hardware not present, switch to container-run via Roland's script. small checklist:
```
- Prewarm dedicated pod: rdedicated-prod-13b-1
- Pull container: ghcr.io/redwood/embed-emulator:20250501
- Run smoke test: curl -sS http://localhost:8080/health
- Switch routing: runbook toggles -> /events/nimbus-embed -> fallback
```
raj - solutions: I'll add the runbook and a one-click fallback script. also prepping a 3-min recorded walkthrough as Plan B.
alex - nimbus-partner: OrbitEdge asked if they can demo a synthetic load with two concurrent sessions. is that supported in the hosted plan or should we reserve Dedicated capacity for the demo window?
kai - ops: For the demo slot (15m at peak) we can schedule a small dedicated pool. i'll reserve 2x A100-equivalent capacity from 10:45-11:30 PT. cost estimate attached in the sheet.
elaine - partnerships: Great — confirm speaker order: 11:00 intro, 11:05 Nimbus keynote (Alex), 11:20 OrbitEdge demo (live, with fallback), 11:35 quick q&a. Sophia: want anything changed?
sophia - marketing: Looks good. i'll prep the event page and add social copy. Request: one short demo clip (30s) for promo — Raj can we get that by Wed?
raj - solutions: Yup. I'll record a 30s highlight + the 3-min fallback by Wed EOD.
ben - eng: One tech ask from my side: OrbitEdge's driver needs a kernel flag that blocks containerized emulation in some cases. if they can't provide a compatible firmware, fallback must be tested end-to-end. can we get their firmware version today?
alex - nimbus-partner: i'll escalate to OrbitEdge firmware lead and get the build id today.
kai - ops: Logistics note: customs paperwork for the dev box — include an HTS code and conclusive value line. If someone is local at the venue, we should plan to receive and validate kit the morning of the event.
elaine - partnerships: Good call. @ben can you and @raj produce a short validation checklist for morning-of? maybe 8 checks we can do in 10 minutes.
ben - eng: Yep — i'll draft it. sample checks: device power, network reachability, model weight download, local inference smoke test, camera mic (if demo needs it), fallback container verification, label verification, spare power adapter.
raj - solutions: I'll add SSH key and team contact in the runbook so onsite staff can trigger fallback without developer handoffs.
shipping-bot: Shipping manifest updated with courier ETA 2025-05-09, consignment ID COURIER-7782. Customs docs uploaded.
elaine - partnerships: Milestones recap: headshots/bios by Fri (Alex), swag SKUs by Mon (Sophia), demo container + 30s clip by Wed (Raj), firmware confirmation by EOD (Alex), courier booked by Tue (Kai). Everyone ok?
sophia - marketing: ok :thumbsup:
ben - eng: ok
raj - solutions: ok
alex - nimbus-partner: ok, i'll push on firmware and headshot now.
kai - ops: I'll schedule the Dedicated capacity and share the reservation ID shortly.
elaine - partnerships: thanks all — i'll update the sheet and ping again if any slips. assigning owners in the doc now. :sparkles:
